vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: news-scout
Version: 1.0.2

The news-scout skill bundle is a legitimate news aggregation tool designed to fetch and summarize AI and financial news. The Python script (scripts/scout.py) uses standard libraries like feedparser and duckduckgo-search to collect data from a predefined list of RSS feeds and search queries in resources/news_sources.json, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection.

llm.summary: Files, instructions, and requirements are consistent with a news-aggregation skill: it fetches RSS and DuckDuckGo results, needs no credentials, and contains no obvious exfiltration or unexpected privileges.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (AI + investing news aggregator) matches the included files: a Python scraper (scout.py) and a news_sources.json list of feeds/search queries. Required capabilities are limited to HTTP fetch and local config; nothing unrelated (e.g., cloud creds) is requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs running the included script or using platform search/fetch tools as a fallback. The runtime instructions reference only the skill's own files and public news sources, and limit results to recent time windows. There are no instructions to read unrelated system files, environment secrets, or to send data to unknown endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only with bundled script). Dependencies are standard Python libs (feedparser, duckduckgo-search, requests) installable from PyPI. No downloads from arbitrary URLs or archive extraction are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, no primary credential, and the code does not read credentials or system config. Network access to RSS/search endpoints is required and proportionate to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request any system-wide or cross-skill configuration changes. It runs as an on-demand script and prints JSON; no elevated or persistent privileges are requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and limited to fetching public news feeds and DuckDuckGo search results; it does not ask for credentials. Before installing: (1) review resources/news_sources.json to ensure you trust the listed sources (and remove any you don't want polled), (2) be aware the script makes outbound HTTPS requests (network access required), (3) running it may surface paywalled items (the config marks paywall sources), and (4) run dependencies in a virtualenv or isolated environment if you prefer. If you need higher assurance, inspect the script locally (scout.py) and test it in a network-restricted sandbox.
